name: Bane
about: Bane the Red (class 1053), Acolyte of the Enclave on Daemon's Crag, a linguist of the Elder Tongue, one of the two mentors; dies if Vardion wins (G[142:2] = 1). INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: When the father cried out Arianna's name, was that the first Truename?
say: Oh, my. Perhaps I should have named you Daemient after all. Fire of the Brain.
Consider it. A daemon is one vanquished by flame. The girl went into the lava. The beast came out. And it stopped at the sound of her name.
If that was a binding, then the first Sorcerer on this crag was not a scholar at all, but a grieving father. How very unlike the histories.
Do not repeat that theory to Vardion. He would not understand it, and then he would be offended that he did not.
